opening.argument: The video presents a hypothetical personal allocation plan rather than a completed gain or a guaranteed result. Its title frames the subject as how the speaker would invest $2,000, while the proposed allocations are tied to projected returns and a three-to-four-year holding period. The speaker expressly characterizes the output as theoretical and states that the outcome is not guaranteed. The promotional material also warns that crypto can be extremely risky and discloses that a small commission may be received when viewers click the links and sign up. The exchange signup promotions are therefore presented with disclosed promotional terms, without evidence of deceptive representation or guaranteed rewards.
